veg.n: Peruvian causa bites with chickpea and corn
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash smooth with the juice of the limes, the ají amarillo paste, the olive oil and salt.
Drain the chickpeas and crush roughly with a fork, then mix with the drained corn kernels and the mayonnaise.
Layer potato, the chickpea mix, sliced avocado and more potato in a tin, chill 1 hour and cut into squares.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the potatoes and crisp the tofu up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; split, top and return to the oven on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Prick the large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 to 70 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside.
Dice the smoked tofu small and fry in a little oil until crisp, then splash with the soy sauce.
Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and add the butter.
Top with the grated cheddar and return to the oven for 5 minutes.
Finish with the crisp tofu, the sour cream and chopped chives.

veg.make_ahead: Skewer the vegetarian frankfurts with the mozzarella up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; make the batter and fry to order

steps.text: Thread the vegetarian frankfurts onto the bamboo skewers with a stick of mozzarella above.
Whisk the self-raising flour, the egg, 2 tablespoons of the caster sugar and the milk into a thick batter, pour into a tall glass, dip each skewer and roll in the panko.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 170C for 4 minutes, roll in caster sugar and drizzle with tomato sauce and mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Cut and crumb the haloumi strips up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; fry just before serving. Mix the dill yoghurt up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Pat the haloumi dry and cut into thick strips.
Dip in the flour, the beaten eggs and the panko, and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden.
Mix the Greek yoghurt with lemon juice and chopped dill and serve with lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; brush the sausages with oil up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Brush the vegetarian smoked sausages with the oil and cook over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred.
Cut into chunks and serve on a board with the wholegrain mustard for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Steam, cool and chill the cakes up to 3 days ahead, covered; slice and pan fry until crisp on the night

ingredients.item: vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce, to taste

steps.text: Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms in hot water. Grate the daikon and simmer in its own juice for 10 minutes.
Fry the finely diced smoked tofu, the chopped soaked shiitake and the sliced spring onions in a little oil for 3 minutes.
Mix into the daikon with the rice flour, the water, the salt and the sugar.
Press into an oiled 20cm square tin and steam 45 minutes.
Cool completely, then slice into squares and fry in oil 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Serve with the vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce and chilli oil.

veg.n: Colony crumbed eggplant fingers with lemon mayo
veg.make_ahead: Make the lemon mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and crumb the eggplant up to 3 hours ahead on a tray in the fridge; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cut the eggplants into finger-sized strips, salt them for 5 minutes and pat dry.
Toss in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the panko mixed with the crumbled nori, the zest of a lemon and salt.
Shallow fry in 1cm oil over medium-high heat for 2 minutes a side until golden, then drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with lemon juice, chopped parsley and dill.
Serve hot with the mayo and lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Make the dressing up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and toast the almonds up to 3 days ahead; cut the wedges and assemble on the night

steps.text: Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with a squeeze of lemon and pepper.
Toast the smoked almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes, cool and chop.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges and scatter with the almonds and the diced tomato.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the broth up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; reheat, then cook the eggplant, tofu puffs and noodles on the night

steps.text: Fry the vegetarian laksa paste for 2 minutes, add the coconut milk and the water and simmer.
Add the eggplant cut into chunks and cook 8 minutes, then the halved tofu puffs.
Cook the rice noodles, divide into bowls, ladle over the laksa and top with bean sprouts.

veg.n: Darwin mango and tofu rice paper rolls
veg.make_ahead: Mix the dipping sauce up to 3 days ahead; slice the tofu, mango and cucumber up to 1 day ahead and roll on the night

steps.text: Soak the rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool.
Slice the smoked tofu into thin strips.
Slice the mangoes and the cucumber into strips.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat, add tofu, mango, cucumber, noodles, mint and Vietnamese mint and roll tightly.
Repeat until all the rolls are made.
Mix the soy sauce, the lime juice, the sugar, the water, the chopped chilli and the crushed garlic clove for dipping.

veg.n: Magda's continental platter with marinated artichokes
veg.make_ahead: Drain the artichokes and slice the smoked tofu up to 1 day ahead, chilled; cut the pickles and slice the rye just before serving

steps.text: Drain the marinated artichokes, slice the smoked tofu thinly and lay them out on a big board.
Add the dill pickles cut into spears, the cream cheese in a bowl and a sliced dark rye loaf, the way Magda would set out a New Year's Eve spread.

veg.n: Macrinus's baked feta with figs and honey (vegetarian)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Put the block of feta in a small baking dish with the mixed olives around it.
Halve the fresh figs and nestle them in.
Drizzle with the olive oil and sprinkle with dried oregano, chilli flakes and thyme sprigs.
Bake 15 minutes until the feta is soft.
Drizzle with the honey and serve with torn crusty bread.

veg.n: Laurel's caramelised onion dip with chips (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Slowly cook the thinly sliced onions in the butter and the olive oil over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until deep brown.
Add the balsamic and cool.
Chop roughly and mix with the sour cream, the soft cream cheese, a dash of soy sauce, the chopped chives, salt and pepper.
Chill 1 hour.
Serve with the kettle chips and the celery sticks.

veg.n: King oyster of the Cave wings
veg.make_ahead: Shred the king oyster mushrooms up to 1 day ahead and keep them covered in the fridge; make the honey sriracha glaze up to 3 days ahead. Batter and fry on the night.

steps.text: Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways and shred them with a fork into thick strips.
Whisk the flour, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt with the cold water into a thick batter.
Heat the vegetable oil to 175C in a deep heavy pot.
Dip the mushroom strips in the batter and fry in batches for 5 minutes until golden and crisp, then drain.
Simmer the honey, sriracha and soy for 4 minutes until glossy and toss the fried mushrooms through.

veg.make_ahead: Press and cut the tofu up to 1 day ahead; crumb and fry just before serving

steps.text: Press the firm tofu dry in paper towel and cut into bite-size pieces.
Roll in the flour mixed with the crumbled nori and salt, then the beaten eggs, then the panko, and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 3 minutes until golden.
Serve with lemon wedges and the tartare sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Melt the chocolate and cream up to 1 day ahead and reheat gently; cut the sponge up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Melt the dark chocolate with the cream and a pinch of salt over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Pour into a warm bowl and serve with the strawberries, the vegetarian marshmallows and a cut-up sponge cake for dipping.

veg.make_ahead: Toss the haloumi with the oil, garlic and chilli up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; grill on the night and serve over ice

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick fingers and toss with the olive oil, the crushed garlic cloves and the chopped red chilli.
Grill on high for 2 to 3 minutes a side until charred.
Pile over a platter of crushed ice and serve straight away with lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the plant-based coney sauce up to 3 days ahead in the fridge; reheat it, grill the frankfurts and fill the buns to serve

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince, breaking it up very fine, then add 1 teaspoon each of the chilli powder, cumin and paprika and the water and cook 10 minutes.
Grill the vegetarian frankfurts and put in the hot dog buns with mustard, the coney sauce and diced onion.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mango sauce up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and crumb the cauliflower up to 4 hours ahead; fry to serve

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-size florets.
Dust in the plain flour, dip in the beaten eggs, then press into the desiccated coconut mixed with the panko.
Fry in the oil at 180C for 4 minutes until golden and tender, then drain.
Simmer the flesh of the mango with the sweet chilli sauce, the juice of the lime and the chopped red chilli for 3 minutes, then blitz smooth.
Serve the cauliflower hot with the sauce.

veg.n: Desk pop beetroot cured bagel bites
veg.make_ahead: Pickle the onion up to 3 days ahead and dress the beetroot up to 1 day ahead, both in the fridge; toast the bagels and build on the day

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and cover with the white vinegar, the sugar and a pinch of salt for 20 minutes. Slice the cooked beetroot paper thin and dress with the soy sauce and a squeeze of lemon.
Beat the cream cheese with the chopped capers, the chopped dill and lemon zest.
Split and toast the mini bagels.
Spread each half with the cream cheese, fold on the beetroot slices, top with drained pickled onion and dill and grind over pepper.

veg.make_ahead: Press the tofu and make the orange sauce up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; coat and fry the tofu just before serving

steps.text: Press the firm tofu dry, cut into bite-sized pieces, toss with a little soy, then in most of the cornflour.
Fry in batches in oil at 180C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp.

Simmer the juice of the oranges with the zest of one of them, a splash of soy, the honey, the rice vinegar, the grated ginger and the crushed garlic clove for 5 minutes, then thicken with the last of the cornflour mixed in water.
Toss the tofu through and top with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the plant-based patties up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; cook on the night

steps.text: Shape the plant-based mince into 12 small patties and season.
Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding half a cheddar slice to each at the end.
Put in the slider buns with sliced dill pickles and tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Fill the sandwiches up to 2 hours ahead, wrapped in the fridge; butter the outsides and cook just before serving

steps.text: Butter the outsides of the slices of bread and fill the sandwiches with the plant-based ham-style slices and the grated cheddar.
Cook in a pan over medium heat for exactly 3 minutes a side and cut into neat triangles.

veg.make_ahead: Best built straight off the grill; dice the onion up to 1 day ahead in a covered container

steps.text: Grill the vegetarian frankfurts until browned all over.
Put in the hot dog buns with diced raw onion, the crispy fried onions, sweet mustard and the tartare sauce.
Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

veg.make_ahead: Crumble and dress the tofu up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; spread and top the crispbreads just before serving

steps.text: Spread the rye crispbreads with the crème fraîche.
Crumble the smoked tofu and toss with a squeeze of lemon and pepper, then pile on with thin pickled cucumber and dill.
Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the plant-based mince with the seasoning up to 2 days ahead and chill; assemble and bake on the night

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince, then stir in the taco seasoning and the water and cook until thick.
Spread the corn chips on a tray, top with the mince and the grated tasty cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes.
Finish with the tomato salsa and the sour cream.

veg.n: Car wash corner store battered onion wings
veg.make_ahead: Cut the onions into petals up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; the ranch can sit in the fridge as well. Batter, fry and toss just before serving.

steps.text: Peel the onions, cut each into 6 wedges and separate into thick petals.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt with the cold water into a thick batter.
Heat the vegetable oil to 180C in a deep heavy pot.
Dip the onion petals in the batter and fry in batches for 3 minutes until golden, then drain.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce, toss the onion through it and serve with the ranch dressing.

veg.n: Bel Air beetroot and black lentil blinis
veg.make_ahead: Cook and dress the lentils and slice the beetroot up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; warm the blinis and top to serve

steps.text: Simmer the black lentils in water for 20 minutes until just tender, drain, cool and dress with the soy sauce and a few drops of lemon juice.
Warm the small blinis at 180C for 4 minutes.
Mix the crème fraîche with the chopped chives and lemon zest, and slice the cooked beetroot into thin ribbons.
Top each blini with a spoon of the cream, a ribbon of beetroot and half a teaspoon of the glossy lentils.
Finish with a tiny dill sprig and a squeeze of lemon and arrange on a platter.

veg.n: From-scratch French onion dip and chips (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Slowly cook the thinly sliced onions in the butter for 25 minutes until deep golden.
Cool and chop.
Mix with the sour cream, the mayonnaise, a little garlic powder, a dash of soy sauce, the chopped chives, salt and pepper.
Chill 1 hour so the flavours settle.
Serve with the thick-cut potato chips.

veg.n: Psych-out pretzel bites with beer cheese (vegetarian)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Roll the pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites.
Simmer 2 litres of the water with the bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds.
Drain, place on lined trays, brush with the beaten egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and the lager, then the grated cheddar and the mustard until smooth.

veg_af.n: Psych-out pretzel bites with cheese sauce (vegetarian, alcohol-free)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Roll the pizza dough into ropes and cut into 3cm bites.
Simmer 2 litres of the water with the bicarb soda and dip the bites for 15 seconds.
Drain, place on lined trays, brush with the beaten egg, sprinkle with rock salt and bake 10 to 12 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk, the vegetable stock and the vinegar, then the grated cheddar and the mustard until smooth.

veg.make_ahead: Make the cheese sauce up to 2 days ahead and reheat with a splash of milk; bake the fries and fry the tofu on the night

steps.text: Bake the frozen thick-cut fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Dice the smoked tofu small and fry in the oil until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer 2 minutes, then stir in the grated cheddar until smooth.
Pile the fries on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and top with the tofu, sliced pickled jalapeños and spring onion.
Serve with the sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Toast the pecans in the maple up to 2 days ahead, airtight, and beat the butter up to 3 days ahead; make the batter and cook the pancakes on the night

steps.text: Whisk the self-raising flour, the sugar, the eggs, the buttermilk and 50g of the melted butter into a thick batter.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes, add 2 tablespoons of the maple syrup, the smoked paprika and a pinch of salt and stir until sticky, then tip onto baking paper to cool.
Cook ladles of batter in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden and risen.
Beat the rest of the soft butter until fluffy.
Stack the pancakes per plate with the smoky pecans and a spoon of butter, and pour over the warm maple syrup.

veg.n: Wolfhouse giant pretzels with mustard butter (vegetarian)

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C.
Divide the pizza dough into equal pieces, roll into 80cm ropes and twist into pretzel shapes.
Simmer the water with the bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds.
Lay on lined trays, brush with the beaten egg, scatter with rock salt and bake 15 to 18 minutes until deep brown.
Beat the soft butter with the wholegrain mustard and the honey.
Serve with sliced radishes tossed in vinegar and salt.

veg.n: Cool beans loaded black bean dip (vegetarian)

steps.text: Fry the diced onion and the crushed garlic cloves in the oil for 5 minutes, add the cumin and the smoked paprika, then the drained black beans and the water.
Simmer 5 minutes and mash roughly with lime juice and salt.
Spread in a baking dish, cover with the grated cheddar and bake at 200C for 10 minutes.
Top with the fresh salsa, the sour cream, sliced jalapeño and coriander.
Serve with the corn chips.

veg.make_ahead: Make the plant-based chilli up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled; reheat, grill the frankfurts and assemble on the night

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with the diced brown onion.
Add the chilli powder, the cumin, the tomato paste, the passata and the water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Grill the vegetarian frankfurts until blistered.
Toast the hot dog buns, add the frankfurts, spoon over the chilli and top with the grated cheddar.
Grill 1 minute to melt, then finish with diced white onion and yellow mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Make the salted caramel up to 5 days ahead in the fridge and warm gently; toast the marshmallows and assemble on the night

steps.text: Make the caramel: melt the sugar until amber, whisk in the cream and the butter, then a little salt and cool.
Lay half the wheatmeal biscuits on a board and top each with a square of milk chocolate.
Toast the vegetarian marshmallows on skewers over a fire or gas flame until golden.
Push one onto each chocolate biscuit, spoon over caramel and squash with a second biscuit.

veg.n: King Argotron's roast battle mushroom drumsticks
veg.make_ahead: Halve and score the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; rub, roast and glaze on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways, score the cut sides and rub with the oil, the crushed garlic cloves, the chopped rosemary, the smoked paprika and salt.
Roast on a lined tray for 20 minutes.
Mix the honey and the wholegrain mustard, brush over and roast 10 minutes more until sticky.
Wrap the stalk ends in baking paper and serve on a board.

veg.n: Sturdy Wings honey soy tempeh wings
veg.make_ahead: Simmer and cut the tempeh up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; make the honey soy glaze up to 3 days ahead. Bake and glaze on the night.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Cut the tempeh into thick fingers, simmer in water for 10 minutes, then drain well.
Toss the tempeh with the vegetable oil and salt and bake on a rack for 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Simmer the honey, soy, garlic, ginger and rice vinegar for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the tempeh in the glaze and scatter with the sesame seeds and spring onions.

veg.make_ahead: Pickle the onion and shred the cabbage up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; mix the chipotle mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead, then batter and fry the haloumi just before serving

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt, and mix the mayonnaise with 1 to 2 chopped chipotle in adobo.
Whisk the flour, the baking powder and the cold lager into a batter.
Cut the haloumi into strips, dip in the batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, haloumi, onion, chipotle mayo and coriander.

veg_af.make_ahead: Pickle the onion and shred the cabbage up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; mix the chipotle mayonnaise up to 2 days ahead, then whisk the batter and fry the haloumi fresh

steps.text: Slice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt, and mix the mayonnaise with 1 to 2 chopped chipotle in adobo.
Whisk the flour, the baking powder and the cold soda water into a batter.
Cut the haloumi into strips, dip in the batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, haloumi, onion, chipotle mayo and coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Fry and pull the jackfruit and toss with the barbecue sauce up to 2 days ahead, then chill; build the nachos and bake on the night

steps.text: Drain the young green jackfruit, fry in the oil with the smoked paprika for 10 minutes, pulling it apart with two forks, then toss with the barbecue sauce.
Spread the corn chips on a big tray and scatter with the jackfruit, the drained black beans and the grated cheddar.
Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until melted.
Mix the sour cream with the juice of the lime and drizzle over.
Top with sliced pickled jalapeños, diced tomato, coriander and spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the spiced plant-based mince up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; make the guacamole just before serving as it browns

steps.text: Fry the plant-based mince with the smoked paprika, the chilli flakes and salt until crisp at the edges.
Warm the refried beans with the cumin.
Spread the corn chips on a big tray, spoon over the beans and mince and cover with the grated cheddar.
Bake at 200C for 10 minutes.
Mash the avocados with lime, salt and chopped coriander.
Top the nachos with guacamole, the sour cream, pickled jalapeños and spring onion.

veg.make_ahead: Press and soak the tofu in the pickle brine up to 1 day ahead in the fridge and mix the dipping sauce up to 2 days ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Press the firm tofu dry, tear into bite-sized pieces and soak in the brine from the dill pickles for 2 hours.
Drain, dip in the beaten egg with the buttermilk, then the plain flour mixed with the paprika and salt.
Fry in the oil at 175C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and toss with dried dill and salt.
Mix the sour cream, the mayonnaise, the chopped pickles and dill for dipping.

veg.n: Smart Tech poker night queso dip (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make the whole dip up to 2 days ahead and chill; reheat gently with a splash of evaporated milk and serve with fresh corn chips

steps.text: Fry the finely chopped button mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika and salt until dark and crisp.
Add half the onion, diced, and the chopped jalapeño for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cornflour, then the evaporated milk, and simmer until it thickens.
Over low heat, stir in the grated cheddar a handful at a time until smooth, then the chopped roasted capsicum and a pinch of cumin.
Serve hot in a skillet with the corn chips and the salted peanuts.
Rub a heavy pot with the halved garlic clove.
Heat the dry white wine until just simmering.
Toss the grated gruyere-style and Swiss-style cheeses with the cornflour and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure eight until smooth.
Stir in the kirsch and a grating of nutmeg.
Keep warm over a burner and serve with the cubed baguette, the boiled baby potatoes and cornichons.
Rub a heavy pot with the halved garlic clove.
Heat the verjuice and the vegetable stock until just simmering.
Toss the grated gruyere-style and Swiss-style cheeses with the cornflour and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure eight until smooth.
Stir in a squeeze of lemon juice and a grating of nutmeg.
Keep warm over a burner and serve with the cubed baguette, the boiled baby potatoes and cornichons.

veg.make_ahead: Roll and slice the rolls with the plant-based pepperoni up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; bake and brush with garlic butter on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C.
Roll the pizza dough into a 30 x 40cm rectangle.
Spread with the pizza sauce and scatter with the plant-based pepperoni slices and the grated mozzarella.
Roll up from the long side and cut into slices.
Place in a lined tin, bake 20 to 25 minutes and brush with the butter melted with the crushed garlic clove.
Warm the marinara sauce for dipping.

veg.n: Jersey mushroom gravy fries with melted cheese
veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom gravy up to 3 days ahead in the fridge and reheat; bake the chips and melt the cheese on the night

steps.text: Bake the frozen crinkle-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Melt the butter and fry the finely chopped button mushrooms until brown, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the vegetable stock and the soy sauce and simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Pile the chips onto a tray, scatter with the grated mozzarella and grill 2 minutes until melted.
Pour over the hot gravy and top with pepper and sliced spring onion.
Pat the dill pickle spears very dry.
Whisk the egg with most of the buttermilk, and mix the plain flour, the fine polenta, the smoked paprika and salt.
Dip the spears in the buttermilk mix, then the flour mix.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and drain.
Mix the sour cream, the last of the buttermilk, the mayonnaise, chopped dill, chives and the crushed garlic clove for dipping.

veg.n: Sweet and Dude mushroom spring rolls
veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom filling up to 2 days ahead and roll up to 1 day ahead, chilled; deep fry on the night

steps.text: Fry the finely chopped button mushrooms in a little of the oil until browned, add the finely shredded cabbage, the grated carrot, the crushed garlic cloves, the vegetarian mushroom oyster sauce and the soy, and cook 3 minutes.
Cool completely.
Roll the filling in each of the spring roll wrappers, sealing the edge with a little water.
Deep fry at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden, then drain on paper towel.
Stir the juice of the lime into the sweet chilli sauce and serve with coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the lentil chilli up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled; reheat it, then bake the chips and grill with the cheese on the night

steps.text: Bake the frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once.

Meanwhile soften the diced onion in the oil, add the smoked paprika, the ground cumin, the chilli powder, the crushed tomatoes, the drained brown lentils and the drained kidney beans, and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Pile the chips into a baking dish, spoon over the chilli, scatter with the grated cheddar and grill 3 minutes until melted.
Top with the sour cream, sliced jalapeños and spring onion.

veg.n: Rally night vegetarian sausages in blankets
veg.make_ahead: Wrap the pastry around the vegetarian frankfurts up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; mix the dip up to 3 days ahead; brush with egg and bake on the night

steps.text: Cut the thawed puff pastry into strips.
Brush each strip with a little Dijon mustard and wrap around the vegetarian cocktail frankfurts.
Lay seam-side down on a lined tray, brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden.
Stir 2 tablespoons of the wholegrain mustard into the honey and the mayonnaise for dipping and serve warm.

veg.n: Grade one capsicum and cheese pinwheels
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep rolled and chilled

steps.text: Mix the cream cheese and mustard until smooth, then spread thinly over the tortillas right to the edges.
Layer the drained roasted capsicum strips, baby spinach and grated cheddar over each tortilla.
Roll up tightly and wrap in cling film.
Chill so the rolls hold their shape.
Trim the ends, cut each roll into pinwheels and serve with cherry tomatoes and cornichons.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep covered and chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and slice.
Slice the smoked tofu thinly and fry in the oil until crisp on both sides.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Build each sandwich with toast, egg, lettuce and tomato, then toast, crisp tofu and lettuce, then the last slice of toast.
Press down gently, pin with toothpicks, trim the crusts and cut into squares. Serve with the potato crisps.

veg.make_ahead: Cut and score the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, chilled; toss with the seasoning, sear and serve straight away

steps.text: Cut the king oyster mushrooms into thick coins, score both sides and toss with the Cajun seasoning.
Sear the mushrooms in a very hot pan with the oil in a single layer, turning once, until well browned.
Drop the heat, add the butter and garlic and swirl until foaming.
Squeeze over the lemon, scatter with chopped parsley and serve from the pan with the baguette.

veg.n: Grandma's cheddar and chive cheese ball (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, soy sauce, garlic powder and most of the chives until smooth.
Shape into a ball and wrap in cling film. Chill until firm.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan, chop finely and mix with the remaining chives.
Roll the cheese ball in the nuts and serve with the water crackers and celery.

veg.n: Brainasium game tester mushroom pizza scrolls
veg.make_ahead: Roll and cut the scrolls up to 1 day ahead, covered in the tin in the fridge; brush with butter and bake on the night

steps.text: Roll the dough on a floured bench into a large rectangle.
Spread with pizza sauce and scatter with the thinly sliced mushrooms, the sliced olives, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Pack into a greased 24cm tin.
Brush with the melted butter and garlic, then bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden.
Warm the marinara and serve for dunking.

veg.n: Shagadelic devilled eggs with smoky crispy shallots
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop out the yolks. Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and salt until smooth.
Toss the crispy fried shallots with half the smoked paprika.
Spoon the yolk mix back into the whites, dust with the rest of the paprika and top with the smoky shallots and chopped chives.

veg.make_ahead: Cube the cheddar, pineapple and tofu up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; thread and spike to serve

steps.text: Cut the rockmelon into pieces and place one piece cut-side down on a platter as the body, with the cloves for eyes.
Cut the cheddar, pineapple and smoked tofu into cubes.
Thread the toothpicks with cheese, pineapple and either a cocktail onion or a cube of tofu.
Push them all over the rockmelon until covered in spikes.

veg.n: Safari camp potato and pea samosas with mint yoghurt
veg.make_ahead: Filled samosas up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender and drain.
Fry the onion and garlic in the tablespoon of oil until soft. Add the curry powder, garam masala, carrot, peas and potatoes and cook, lightly crushing, then stir through the coriander and cool.
Cut the wrappers into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles, sealing with water.
Fry in the oil for frying at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Mix the yoghurt with the mint and a pinch of salt for dipping and serve with the hot samosas.

veg.n: Monastery mushroom and tofu momos with chilli tomato sauce
veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom and tofu filling up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; pleat the momos and steam on the night, and make the sauce up to 3 days ahead

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 crushed for the filling and 1 for the sauce

steps.text: Fry the finely chopped mushrooms in the vegetable oil until dry and browned, then cool and mix with the crumbled tofu, ginger, two of the garlic cloves, spring onions, soy and sesame oil.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edges and pleat closed.
Steam in a lined steamer over boiling water for 10 minutes.
Blitz the tomatoes, chillies, remaining garlic, salt and vinegar, then simmer to make the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Tear and soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk up to 4 hours ahead; mix the sriracha mayo up to 2 days ahead and fry at the last minute

steps.text: Tear the oyster mushrooms into 8 large clusters and soak in the buttermilk with salt.
Toss the mushrooms in the flour mixed with paprika and garlic powder, pressing it on well.
Shallow fry in the vegetable oil at 180C, turning once, until deep golden and crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Toss the cabbage with the vinegar.
Toast the buns and fill with the crispy mushrooms, slaw, pickles and sriracha mayo.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Toss the nuts with the honey, oil, chilli, paprika and rosemary.
Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C, stirring twice, until golden.
Sprinkle with sea salt while hot and cool so the coating crisps.
Serve in a bowl next to the sliced plant-based jerky.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the salt and chilli powder for the rim up to 1 week ahead and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled. Add the lager and soy sauce to each glass on the night

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer. Rub a lime wedge around each glass rim and dip into the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, a couple of dashes of hot sauce and a dash of soy sauce to each.
Top each with a bottle of cold lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.

veg_af.n: Vicki St. Elmo's debrief michelada (vegetarian, alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Mix the salt and chilli powder for the rim up to 1 week ahead and juice the limes up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled. Chill the alcohol-free lager and build each glass to order

steps.text: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer. Rub a lime wedge around each glass rim and dip into the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, a couple of dashes of hot sauce and a dash of soy sauce to each.
Top each with a bottle of cold alcohol-free lager, stir gently and serve with a lime wedge.

veg.n: Cat lady cover croque monsieur bites (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Make the bechamel up to 2 days ahead, chilled; assemble the sandwiches up to 4 hours ahead, then fry and grill to serve

steps.text: Melt some of the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Season with nutmeg and stir in a little of the cheese.
Spread the bread thinly with Dijon and make sandwiches with the plant-based ham-style slices and more cheese.
Fry the sandwiches in the rest of the butter on both sides.
Spread the bechamel on top, scatter with the last of the cheese and grill until bubbling.
Cut into fingers and serve with cornichons.

veg.n: Boston mushroom and corn chowder with crackers
veg.make_ahead: Make the chowder base through to the tender potato up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; add the corn and cream on the night

steps.text: Fry the torn oyster mushrooms in the butter with the smoked paprika until golden, then add the onion and celery and cook until soft.
Stir in the flour, then the vegetable stock, the kombu and the potato. Simmer until the potato is tender.
Cut the kernels from the corn cobs, add and simmer 4 minutes, then lift out the kombu.
Stir in the cream and heat through. Season with pepper and serve with the crackers and chopped chives.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower into florets and make the blue cheese dip up to 1 day ahead and keep both chilled. Coat, bake and toss on the night.

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets and toss with the olive oil, baking powder and salt.
Bake on a rack at 220C for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Mash the blue cheese with the sour cream, mayonnaise and a squeeze of lemon for the dip.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the cauliflower through it. Serve with the dip and celery.

veg.make_ahead: Make the plant-based mince and bean mix up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; reheat, layer, bake and top on the night

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with the onion. Add the cumin, paprika, chilli powder, tomato paste and a splash of water and simmer. Stir in the black beans.
Layer the corn chips in a baking dish with the mince and cheddar.
Bake at 200C until the cheese melts.
Mash the avocados with lime and salt.
Top with guacamole, sour cream, tomato salsa and jalapenos.

veg.n: My name is Jeff hearts of palm cakes
veg.make_ahead: Mix and chill the hearts of palm cakes up to 1 day ahead, covered; finish with the panko and fry on the night

steps.text: Drain the hearts of palm, pat dry and shred with a fork. Mix with 3 tablespoons of the mayonnaise, the egg, spring onions, lemon zest, mustard, the crumbled nori and half the panko.
Shape into small cakes and chill.
Roll the cakes in the remaining panko.
Fry in the oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Mix the remaining mayonnaise with the chipotle and a squeeze of lime. Serve with lime wedges.

veg.n: Frat house sticky barbecue tofu wings
veg.make_ahead: Press and tear the tofu up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; make the glaze up to 3 days ahead. Bake and glaze on the night.

steps.text: Wrap the tofu in a clean tea towel and press it under a heavy pan for 15 minutes, then tear it into 4 cm chunks.
Toss the tofu with the cornflour, paprika, olive oil and salt until every piece is coated.
Spread the tofu on two lined trays and bake at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until crisp.
Simmer the barbecue sauce with the honey, soy and cider vinegar for 5 minutes until sticky.
Toss the hot tofu in the glaze and return to the oven for 5 minutes to caramelise.
Scatter with the sesame seeds and spring onions.

veg.n: Frat party lentil, mushroom and fennel sausage rolls
veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil and mushroom filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; roll, glaze and bake on the day

steps.text: Fry the finely chopped mushrooms and onion in the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Drain and roughly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, apple, fennel, breadcrumbs, half the beaten egg, salt and pepper.
Cut the pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.
Brush with the rest of the egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut each roll into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Stir the paprika into the relish and serve alongside.

veg.n: The last chocolate caramel nougat bar (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 5 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the vegetarian marshmallows with the butter, stir in the malted milk powder and vanilla, and press into a lined 20cm square tin.
Melt the caramels with the cream until smooth and spread over the nougat.
Chill.
Melt the chocolate with the oil and pour over the top.
Chill until set, then cut into bars with a hot knife.

veg.n: Ranch pretzel and peanut snack mix (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Melt the butter with the soy sauce, ranch seasoning, paprika and garlic powder.
Toss with the pretzels, corn chips, crackers and peanuts in a large roasting tin.
Bake at 150C, stirring every ten minutes.
Cool on the tray so it crisps, then tip into a very big bowl.

veg.n: Future cheese fries with vegetarian chicken salt
veg.make_ahead: Dice the tofu up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry it, bake the chips and make the cheese sauce on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp, then toss with the vegetarian chicken salt.
Dice the smoked tofu small and fry in the oil until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick.
Stir in the cheddar and mustard until smooth.
Pile the chips on a platter, pour over the cheese sauce and scatter with the crisp tofu and spring onion.

veg.n: Greeting card cheese and tomato pinwheels (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Roll the log up to 1 day ahead and keep it wrapped in the fridge; slice, brush with egg and bake to serve

steps.text: Lay the pastry flat and spread with the pesto. Top with the drained roasted capsicum strips, basil leaves and cheese.
Roll up tightly and chill.
Cut each roll into slices and lay cut-side down on a lined tray. Brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
